RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday,  the March 13, 2008/Phalguna 23, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Coal; Communications and
Information Technology; Development of North Eastern Region;
Environment and Forests; External Affairs; Housing and
Urban Poverty Alleviation; Overseas Indian Affairs;
Panchayati Raj; Personnel, Public Grievances and
Pensions; Planning; Shipping, Road Transport
and Highways; Space; Statistics and
Programme Implementation;
Urban Development; Youth
Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
62
Support to schemes for the poor
*201. SHRI R. SHUNMUGA-
SUNDARAM: Will the Minister of
HOUSING AND URBAN POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the schemes under which the State
Governments are being supported while
providing alternative houses for the slum
dwellers; and
(b) whether there are schemes executed
by his Ministry where the dilapidated
houses of the poor are either repaired or
rebuilt?
Status of Commonwealth Games,
2010
*202. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) the status in respect of preparation
of the 2010 Commonwealth Games to be
held in our country;
(b) the additional infrastructure that
would be added for the games; and
(c) the support given by Government
to Indian teams in various disciplines in
respect of preparation for the 2010 games?
Sports infrastructure in Orissa
*203. SHRI BHAGIRATHI MAJHI:
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has extended
any financial assistance to Orissa for sports
infrastructure development during the last
four years;
(b) if so, the details of projects/
proposals for which Government has
extended the grant/financial assistance to
Orissa during the last four years;
(c) whether any such projects/
proposals are pending with Government
for consideration from Orissa at present;

63
(d) if so, by when all these pending
proposals/projects would be considered;
(e) whether Government has any
technical hurdle to consider these pending
projects; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Inclusion of Warangal and Tirupati
under JNNURM
*204. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Andhra Pradesh has requested the Union
Government to include two cities of
Warangal and Tirupati in 'C' category of
select cities under Jawaharlal Nehru
National Urban Renewal Mission
(JNNURM);
(b) if so, the complete details in this
regard;
(c) the response of the Union
Government in this regard; and
(d) by when this request is likely to be
given clearance?
Spectrum controversy
*205. SHRIMA TI SUPRIYA SULE:
Will the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the country's National
Security Advisor was asked to step in to
resolve spectrum controversy and has met
Department of Telecommunications,
Telecom Regulatory Authority and Telecom
in the month of February to discuss the
issue;
(b) if so, the outcome of the discussions
held;
(c) whether all the hurdles that were
preventing clearance of spectrum have been
removed; and
(d) if so, by when final decision about
the spectrum is considered?
Eleventh Plan outlay
*206. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether National Development
Council has, recently, approved the
Eleventh Plan outlays for various sectors;
(b) if so, the details thereof alongwith
the details of the outlays;
(c) the reasons for late convening of
NDC even when the Eleventh Plan started
in April, 2007 and, as a result, the
allocations for various sectors would
actually start in 2009 only; and
(d) the action proposed to be taken
against those responsible for the late
convening of NDC?
Central assistance for drinking water
in cities
*207. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a proposal under
consideration of Government to provide
assistance to ten cities in the country which
would undertake to provide drinking water
to the population throughout the day and
all the seven days in the week, i.e. on 24x7
basis;
(b) if so, the names of cities where such
projects are proposed to be undertaken and
the basis on which Central assistance is to
be provided; and
(c) by when the projects are likely to be
completed?

64
